title: Mosher C NDE 708
content:
I was three weeks overdue for my baby and given one cubic centimeter of a drug - which did not work in inducing labor. The next day they upped it to one and a half cubic centimeters and within ten minutes, I was in terrible labor. I was rushed to the emergency room and from then on, all I can recall is as follows: Rushing down (or up) a passageway of sound and lights finally coming to the end of the passage, to the light, where I was met by three beautiful people who informed me that they had come to help me over. Behind them, I could see great beauty, glorious flowers and green pastures. I replied that I could not go in there. They smiled and said that everybody came there - to which I replied, even me? If that is the case, I must go back and tell everyone! To which they smiled and said but no one will believe you. My answer was, 'Oh yes they will.' My husband was an air force officer so I got lucky (!) and a bishop came to visit me. I told him of my experience and to my utter amazement, all he did was smile and tell me that I had been under drugs and this was all imagination. After that, I gave up trying to tell people - so you see my wonderful friends in white were right, they did not believe me. Nowadays it is different; people are more ready to listen.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Childbirth My uterus would not contract and I was bleeding heavily so much so that when I was in recovering the nurses told me they thought that they had lost me.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Light | A landscape or city | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I felt that I had become part of the universe for as I was traveling the passage to the light I learned many things. Which, of course, I have forgotten.
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: A sort of yunk, yung, yung sound.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes This I have already explained. I did not know them and the communication was telepathic.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes I saw many different colored lights.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm Beauty, peace and love.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe Only what I have previously described.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I felt I had to return to tell people what I knew and what I had seen. Emotionally I was elated.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes My belief in humanity was much stronger.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes No one would believe me, not even an Anglican bishop who visited me whilst I was in hospital.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: It was all a very wonderful experience - I wanted to go back.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Most scoffed - save my husband, but even he said not to tell people for they would think me mad.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: No, I think it is well covered.
